{{Quote|Are you going to pay for that? It costs seven wupiupi.|[[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]]|translated=1|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''wupiupi''' was a unit of [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] currency, used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] before the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It took sixteen wupiupi to equal a [[Trugut/Legends|trugut]], which itself was a quarter of a [[Peggat/Legends|peggat]]. The value of one wupiupi was around 0.625 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credits]], the main [[Currency/Legends|currency]] in use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SOT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> According to [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]], a [[Gorgmonger/Legends|gorgmonger]] that worked in the marketplace of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], the [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]] at her shop cost seven wupiupi.<ref name="TPM" /> The young [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]] reported that it took ten thousand wupiupi to [[Smuggler|smuggle]] a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] off world,<ref name="Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker">''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> while five wupiupi would generally be enough to buy a ticket to a public slave execution.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>
